title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Inland Letter. Keep it, take the pick, go standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Inland Letter
options.lineage: India Post inland letter cards and franked envelopes
options.thesis: The portfolio as a letter from Hyderabad: one pale-blue sheet, sections folded along perforated seams.
options.viewport: Sender line, a huge navy headline, a red Hyderabad postmark beside a printed indicia box holding role and availability, and a ruled To: block with the two actions.
options.risk: Tips into costume if postal props multiply; it holds only with one postmark and real fold lines doing the dividing.

raised.raise: Experience, projects and education read as ruled tabular rows in fixed columns (date, item, status), like a register, not cards.
Surface hierarchy comes from tint levels of the one blue (screened 6%, 12%, solid), never from shadows.
A fixed left rail carries the section index and number on every fold, so wayfinding never leaves the sheet.

options.label: Ruled Notebook
options.lineage: Classmate ruled notebooks with an index page
options.thesis: Every Indian engineer's ruled notebook: blue rules, a red margin, and an index page that is the navigation.
options.viewport: A headline sitting on the ruling with the margin at left, and the index table top-right listing sections with page numbers.
options.risk: Familiar: notebook and graph-paper portfolios are where many runs in this category land.

options.label: Split-flap concourse
options.risk: Dark board conflicts with the light theme you asked for.
options.case: Fuses poorly with a light, subtle site.
options.kept: Ruled rows in fixed columns for experience and projects.

options.label: Manga screentone page
options.risk: Too loud for recruiters scanning in 60 seconds.
options.kept: Tint levels instead of shadows for surface hierarchy.

options.label: Shareware installer
options.risk: Gates content a recruiter needs instantly.
options.kept: A fixed side rail carrying the section index.

options.label: Hand-bent neon
options.viewport: A neon script in a dark room.
options.risk: Dark and glowing: the look you called AI-generated.

options.label: Sleeping city fold
options.thesis: A city folding like a quilt.

options.label: Algorave floor
options.viewport: A code buffer at stage scale.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white developer portfolio, executed carefully.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, image block right, blue button.
